sn35.166:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ
sn35.166:1.3: kathannu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyatīti?
sn35.166:1.4: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati.
sn35.166:1.5: rūpe dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati.
sn35.166:1.6: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati.
sn35.166:1.7: cakkhusamphassaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati. yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe… jivhaṃ …pe… kāyaṃ …pe… manaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati. dhamme dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati. manoviññāṇaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati. manosamphassaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati.
sn35.166:1.8: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati.
sn35.166:1.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati.
